lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Where the tide meets the cooling sand
I trace the lines upon your hand
A ghost of salt upon the breeze
Among the shadows of the coastal trees
[Pre-Chorus]
The sun begins its slow descent
A golden hour of time well spent
[Chorus]
You are the lighthouse in my chest
A steady heart where memories rest
Like waves that fold upon the shore
I find the love I was looking for
[Verse]
Your voice is hum of distant wire
A spark of warmth in a fading fire
We walked the path where the wild grass grows
In the quiet space that the evening knows
[Pre-Chorus]
The silver moon begins to climb
Folding the day into the seams of time
[Chorus]
You are the lighthouse in my chest
A steady heart where memories rest
Like waves that fold upon the shore
I find the love I was looking for
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
The secrets whispered in the gray
The words we meant but couldn't say
[Chorus]
You are the lighthouse in my chest
A steady heart where memories rest
Like waves that fold upon the shore
I find the love I was looking for
[Outro]
